paper.title_en: Outer trapped surface formation from gravitational waves collision
paper.abstract_en: We give a new rigorous construction of outer trapped surface formation in smooth vacuum spacetimes without symmetry assumptions. The outer trapped surface is produced by the collision of two transversely localized, nearly plane-fronted gravitational waves described by short pulse data. The outer trapped surface is obtained by joining two smooth pieces along a curve with their future-directed outer null normals matching continuously. The incompleteness of the maximal future development is then established by adapting Penrose's original argument. This construction is inspired by Penrose's argument in constructing a marginally outer trapped surface in the collision of two ultra-relativistic particles modeled by the Aichelburg--Sexl solution.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在无对称性假设的光滑真空时空中，用短脉冲数据的引力波碰撞给出外陷获面形成的新严格构造，并借此建立最大未来发展的不完备性，属于广义相对论基础与陷获面/奇点定理方向的严格数学工作；受Penrose构造边际外陷获面论证启发，理论深度与方法严谨性信号较强。因论文仅1天龄，零引用视为中性，不扣分。
decision.title_zh: 引力波碰撞产生外陷获面
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在无对称性假设的光滑真空时空中，给出了外陷获面形成的一个新的严格构造。该外陷获面由两束横向局域化、近乎平面波前的引力波碰撞产生，这两束引力波由短脉冲数据描述。外陷获面是通过沿一条曲线拼接两块光滑片段而得到的，且两片段的未来指向外零法向在该曲线上连续匹配。随后，通过改写Penrose的原始论证，确立了最大未来发展的不完备性。这一构造受到Penrose论证的启发：在由Aichelburg--Sexl解建模的两个超相对论粒子碰撞中构造边际外陷获面。
